description:
REDTWIN SCOUT is an independent research and software project exploring Earth–Mars terrain analogues using open NASA and USGS scientific data.

Our goal is to develop an explainable AI system that analyzes planetary terrain measurements, identifies similar environments on Earth, and presents scientifically supported results through interactive maps and visualizations.

Interests: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Python, Geospatial Analysis, Earth Science and Planetary Exploration.
